onboarding.step1Description: Enter the ultimate arena in crypto. Collect rare cocks, breed champions and fight for dominance with $CFC on the line.
onboarding.step2Description: Choose your username and enter a referral code if you have one. This is how other players will know you in the arena!
onboarding.step3Description: This is your home base. View your cock collection, check your inventory, and manage your eggs in the incubator.
onboarding.step4Description: Pair your cocks with chickens to create eggs. Higher rarity parents increase chances of legendary offspring!
onboarding.step5Description: Challenge other players in the fight for glory. Wager $CFC and prove your cock's worth. Spectators can join the action and place their own wagers too.
onboarding.step6Description: Spin the wheel to pull rare cocks and chickens. Rarity means bigger rewards from spectator wagers. Stock up on items to keep your fighters in top shape.
